title: SWF e2e: Ruffle oracles for multi-flag PlaceObject combos (blend+filters+cacheAsBitmap; move with blend+filters+clipActions)
description: Test-coverage hardening identified by a read-only SWF-compiler audit (no bug found — the byte order is correct, but these combinations have NO Ruffle e2e oracle, and per CLAUDE.md Ruffle pixel/behavior oracles are the acceptance truth; field-order regressions on PlaceObject have bitten before — tasks 1240, 1349). ADD apps/desktop/e2e Playwright+bundled-Ruffle oracle tests (follow the existing e2e patterns, e.g. mask-named-clip-1349.spec.ts, merge-drawing-oracle.spec.ts) covering these currently-unpinned PlaceObject2/3 flag combinations rendered/run in real Ruffle: (1) a SHAPE placed with blendMode != normal AND enabled filters AND cacheAsBitmap simultaneously (PlaceObject3 with HasBlendMode+HasFilterList+HasCacheAsBitmap) — assert it renders (pixel oracle) without Ruffle parse error; (2) an INSTANCE MOVE that carries blend+filters on the PlaceObject3 followed by the separate PlaceObject2 Move with clipActions (the frames.ts move path) — assert the clip's onClipEvent runtime behavior fires AND the blend/filter render is correct after the move; (3) a SYMBOL-INTERNAL (sprite.ts) placement with filters+blend to mirror the scene-level coverage. Use trace-based behavior assertions where pixels are ambiguous. These pin the exact field-order/flag-co-occurrence the audit verified by hand but couldn't prove at runtime. NO production code change expected; if a test reveals a real Ruffle mismatch, STOP and report it (do not patch byte logic without oracle confirmation). VERIFY: the new e2e specs pass against bundled Ruffle; full ordered build + swf unit suite green (flash8-empty.fla gates may SKIP per 1207); existing e2e/golden not regressed. ACQUIRE lock; commit incl task file; push origin/main rebase-retry (keep origin .counter on conflict). Note in docs/ which combos are now Ruffle-pinned.
